pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Cisco Secure Client, the product formerly sold as AnyConnect, is a proprietary SSL and IPsec/IKEv2 VPN client. This package carries the core VPN module only — no Network Visibility, ISE posture, Umbrella or AMP components.
The installer is not publicly downloadable: it comes from software.cisco.com behind an account with an entitled service contract, so RESTRICT=fetch applies and the .sh has to be staged in DISTDIR by hand. The ebuild unpacks that self-extracting archive and installs its payload directly, instead of running the vendor's vpn_install.sh, which writes outside the image root and enables the service itself.

use.flag: Install vpnui, the GTK3 connection window, together with its desktop entry and icons. Without it the client is driven entirely through the vpn command-line tool.

Install libacfeedback.so, the Customer Experience Feedback plugin, which reports usage data back to Cisco. Off by default. Omitting it is a vendor-supported configuration — the stock installer deletes the same file when a deployment sets DisableCustomerExperienceFeedback in ACTransforms.xml.

Install acwebhelper, the embedded browser used for SAML/SSO authentication. This is the only binary in the package that links net-libs/webkit-gtk:4, and it is independent of gui — vpnui itself is plain GTK3. Disabling it leaves SAML logins to acextwebhelper, which opens the desktop browser instead.
